name: Burn the Midnight Oil
source:
It’s 1986 in North Haven – a neon-drenched city where monsters blend into the crowd.

Play as Circe, a seductive vampire detective, or Dante, a reckless hellhound cop. Investigate gruesome murders, track forbidden magic, and protect the secrets that keep you alive. Romance might bloom – but some hearts beat far too dark.

[From [url=https://teamfoxglove.itch.io/burn-the-midnight-oil]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1986年的北黑文 (North Haven) 是一座霓虹闪烁的城市，怪物们融入人群之中。

扮演瑟西（Circe），一位迷人的吸血鬼侦探，或但丁（Dante），一位鲁莽的地狱猎犬警察。调查可怕的谋杀案，追踪禁忌魔法，并保护让你活下去的秘密。浪漫也许会绽放——但有些人的心却跳得过于黑暗。

[来自[url=https://teamfoxglove.itch.io/burn-the-midnight-oil]Itch.io[/url]]
